CENTRAL. I. O.
December 31, 1925
REPORT ON Russians in Marshal Chang Chung Chang's Army.
By P. C. C. Kedrolivansky Forwarded by J.R. Grieve C.S.D.
Sir,
Enquiries made by the undersigned in Nanking show
that 1,665 Russian troops came to Pukow and Nanking with Marshal
Chang Chung Chang about the middle of December, and were under
orders at the end of that month to return to Tsinanfu. These
troops consist of 750 artillery gunners and machine gunners, 185
and 500 infantry
bombers and 130 cavalry. The artillery and machine gunners
are distributed among four armoured trains, the armament of
each of which includes 2 field guns and 16 machine guns. All
these Russians have white sympathies, and all, except a few,
have previously served in the armies of Admiral Koltchak or
Ataman Semenoff. About 30% of them are Tartars, 50% are
Cossacks and the remaining 20% are serving in the commissioned
ranks.
Inquiries made by the undersigned among these troops
show that the Russian corps in Marshal Chang's Army is comprised
as follows:
1,200 men belonging to 65th infantry division under
General Nechaieff.
600 men belonging to 105th Infantry Regiment under
General Semonidze
200 adult cadets under Colonel Sokoloff
130 cavalry belonging to the bodyguard of Marshal Chang Chung
Chang and under the command of Colonel Tanaeff.
185 bomb throwers belonging to grenade division under
Colonel Semenoff.
（左侧竖排批注：Copies for CG 5rc Comc ad. be）

1925年12月31日
关于张宗昌元帅部队中俄国人的报告。
由 P. C. C. Kedrolivansky 呈报，经 J.R. Grieve（刑事侦缉处）转递。

先生：

卑职在南京进行的调查显示，约在12月中旬，有1,665名俄国士兵随张宗昌元帅抵达浦口和南京，并于该月底奉命返回济南府。这些部队由750名炮兵和机枪手、185名掷弹兵、500名步兵以及130名骑兵组成。炮兵和机枪手分布在四列装甲列车上，每列列车的武器配备包括2门野战炮和16挺机枪。所有这些俄国人皆同情白军，且除少数人外，此前均曾在高尔察克海军上将或谢苗诺夫阿塔曼的军队中服役。其中约30%为鞑靼人，50%为哥萨克人，其余20%担任委任军官职务。

卑职在这些部队中进行的查询显示，张元帅军队中的俄国军团构成如下：

1,200人，隶属于涅恰耶夫将军指挥的第65步兵师。
600人，隶属于谢莫尼泽将军指挥的第105步兵团。
200名成年学员，隶属于索科洛夫上校。
130名骑兵，隶属于张宗昌元帅的卫队，由塔纳耶夫上校指挥。
185名掷弹兵，隶属于谢苗诺夫上校指挥的掷弹兵师。
（左侧竖排批注：副本送总巡官 5份 抄送行政处）

Shanghai Municipal Police.
________________________________________ Station.
________________________________________ 192

REPORT ON ________________________________________

Made by ________________________ Forwarded by ________________________

- 2 -

700 cavalry belonging to the cavalry regiment under
Colonel Saraeff.
750 men belonging to the armoured train division under
General Tchekhoff.
------
Total 3765.

Like those of their number now in Nanking, all
of these men are Tartars and Cossacks, and all are "white"
politically.

The Russian Corps of Marshal Chang Chung Chang's
army is now endeavouring to find fresh recruits, and two armoured
trains called the "Peking" and "Mukden" are being constructed
in Tsinanfu for their use. Each of these trains will be armed
with a Howitzer in addition to the usual complement of field
guns and machine guns.

Besides the Russians in General Chang Chung Chang's
army he is planning to engage 200 for his fleet at Tsingtao
which is under Admiral Pi Shew Chang (畢庶澄). Eighty of
these men have been engaged in Shanghai, and about half of
these have already left for Tsingtao. These men will be used
to man the flag ship of Admiral Pi.

（批：R.W.M 4 JAN 1927） （批：M Currie B）

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
V. Kadrivanoff
P. C. C.

D. C. I.

- 2 -

700名骑兵，隶属于萨拉耶夫上校指挥的骑兵团。
750人，隶属于切霍夫将军指挥的装甲列车师。
------
总计 3765人。

与目前身在南京的同袍一样，这些人均为鞑靼人和哥萨克人，且在政治立场上均属于“白军”阵营。

张宗昌元帅军队中的俄国军团目前正在努力招募新兵，两列名为“北京”号和“沈阳”号的装甲列车正在济南府为他们建造。除了通常配备的野战炮和机枪外，每列列车还将装备一门榴弹炮。

除了在张宗昌将军军队中的俄国人外，他还计划为其在青岛的海军舰队雇佣200人，该舰队由毕庶澄海军上将指挥。其中80人已在上海受雇，约有一半人已前往青岛。这些人将被用于配备毕海军上将的旗舰。

（批注：R.W.M 1927年1月4日） （批注：M Currie B）

先生，
您忠顺的仆人，
V. Kadrivanoff
警署首席翻译员
